steps.title: Gateway Architecture
steps.text: The Surgewave Gateway exposes REST endpoints, gRPC services, and WebSocket handlers that connect external clients to Surgewave brokers through a unified interface.

steps.title: Protocol Comparison
steps.text: REST offers universal compatibility and easy debugging. gRPC provides compact binary streaming. WebSocket enables real-time bidirectional communication.

steps.title: Confluent v3 API Compatibility
steps.text: Surgewave implements the Confluent REST Proxy v3 API for cluster, topic, producer, consumer, and consumer group operations, enabling drop-in compatibility.

steps.title: WebSocket Streaming
steps.text: Subscribe to topics in real-time via WebSocket. The protocol supports ping/pong heartbeats, topic subscriptions, message production, and offset commits.

steps.title: Key Concepts
steps.text: The gateway supports multi-cluster routing, JSON transcoding between gRPC and REST, and WebSocket subscriptions for real-time browser applications.
